# GitHub Configuration & Governance

This directory contains GitHub community guidelines, issue templates, security policy, and pull request rules.

## Directory Structure
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: Standardized templates for bug reports and feature requests.
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`: Quality checklist and PR submission template.
- `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`: Contributor community standards.
- `SECURITY.md`: Security vulnerability disclosure policy.
